instruction:
Work from a terminal with CalculiX 2.21 (`/usr/bin/ccx`).

`/home/user/Desktop/report.md` is the ONLY source of the truss data. Read the report (nodes, members, area, supports, load, material), then reconstruct and solve the two-bar truss with T3D2 elements:
- 3 nodes and 2 members exactly as reported
- one `*Solid Section` with the reported area line
- supports exactly as reported (both base nodes pinned in x/y, all nodes fixed in z)
- apply the reported load at node 3

Submit with `/usr/bin/ccx` and produce `/home/user/Desktop/solution.inp` and `/home/user/Desktop/solution.dat`. Results reach `.dat` through `*Node Print` with an explicit node set.

Write `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as two comma-separated numbers: `ux3, uy3` — the x and y displacements of node 3, in mm.

The evaluator re-solves your deck independently; the reported numbers must come from your own run.
